purpose: Closed list of AWS target options for the refactor (modern) path. The LLM chooses one option per piece and justifies it by the priorities, in order. The first option of each piece type is the default (the replatform target) when the LLM does not decide.

retired_or_closed.AWS App Runner: closed to new customers on 2026-04-30; use Amazon ECS Express Mode
retired_or_closed.Amazon QLDB: shut down on 2025-07-31; use Aurora PostgreSQL with pgAudit

piece_types.label: Service / API (container with HTTP or SOAP entry points)

options.when: steady traffic; default for containerized services
options.cost: pay per vCPU/GB-hour, no idle servers to manage; Compute Savings Plans apply
options.security: task-level IAM role, no hosts to patch
options.performance: no cold start; scales by tasks

options.service: Amazon ECS on AWS Fargate Spot
options.when: stateless service with 2+ tasks that tolerates interruptions (non-critical or behind retries)
options.performance: tasks can be reclaimed with 2 minutes notice

options.when: simple web app or API that wants the least setup (successor of App Runner)
options.cost: Fargate pricing plus the load balancer it provisions

options.when: low or intermittent traffic, short requests (< 29 s), stateless
options.cost: pay per request, scales to zero; expensive at high sustained load
options.performance: cold starts (SnapStart for Java/.NET/Python); 15 min limit

options.when: high steady load where per-instance price wins, or needs OS access
options.cost: cheapest compute at sustained load with Savings Plans; Graviton ~20% cheaper than x86

options.when: many services (about 15+) and a team that already runs Kubernetes
options.cost: fixed control-plane fee per cluster plus compute
options.security: rich policy options, more to configure

options.service: Merge into another service (name it in merge_into)
options.when: tiny service that already moves in the same wave group (same database, or called only by the other one)
options.cost: one less task/deployment to pay and run
options.performance: in-process call instead of a network call

options.service: Amazon ECS on AWS Fargate (long-running consumer)
options.when: constant message flow or long processing
options.cost: pays while running, even when idle

options.service: AWS Lambda triggered by Amazon SQS
options.when: bursty or low volume, each message handled in < 15 min
options.cost: pay per invocation, zero when idle
options.performance: scales with the queue; cold starts

options.service: Amazon ECS on AWS Fargate Spot
options.when: idempotent consumer that tolerates interruptions
options.performance: can be reclaimed; messages return to the queue

options.when: the handling is a multi-step flow with retries/compensation

options.service: Merge into another service (name it in merge_into)
